I live here in Somalie, the rain is not much and it comes when it wants. This maize plot is small, only a little piece, and I plant beans with it like my father did. I have no money to buy the fertilizer from town, and the bag is too big for my small plot anyway — my neighbors here also do not buy it. I keep the seed from last harvest, it is the seed that knows our land. When the goats come back to the kraal I carry some of their droppings to the plot, that is what helps the soil.

I weed with my wife and the children when they are not at the animals, and if the rain is short I cannot do anything — I have no water to carry to this plot. If the army worm comes I pick them by hand, I do not buy the medicine. Maybe at planting time when I must finish quick I call my brother's son for two or three days and give him food and a little something.
